| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `areOptionsAvailable()` | Checks if there are any available options that you can click on |
| `canContinue()` | Checks if you can continue in a dialogue via "Click here to continue" or "Click to continue" |
| `canEnterInput()` | Returns true if you are able to enter input into the dialogue (like withdrawing X from bank and such) |
| `chooseFirstOption(String... options)` | This will go through the provided options in order, and will choose the first available. |
| `chooseFirstOptionContaining(String... options)` | This will go through the provided options in order, and will choose the first available option that contains one of your provided options. |
| `chooseOption(int optionIndex)` | Chooses whether to click the given option index or press the key based on mouse distance and profiled values. |
| `chooseOption(String option)` | Chooses the index of the given option NOT CASE SENSITIVE |
| `clickContinue()` | Attempts to click the continue dialogue |
| `clickOption(int optionIndex)` | Clicks the given option index. |
| `clickOption(String option)` | Clicks a dialogue option with the mouse NOT CASE SENSITIVE |
| `continueDialogue()` | Chooses either to click continue or press space to continue based on a profiled distance of your mouse |
| `getNPCDialogue()` | Gets the dialogue text in a conversation. |
| `getOptionIndex(String option)` | Gets the index of the option. |
| `getOptionIndexContaining(String option)` | Gets the option index that contains the given text. |
| `getOptions()` | Gets all the available options in the dialogue, not including "Click here to continue" |
| `inDialogue()` | Checks if you're currently in a dialogue screen. |
| `isProcessing()` | Checks if the "Please wait..." widget is present, can be found after clicking the continue button |
| `spaceToContinue()` | Uses the space bar to continue |
| `typeOption(int optionIndex)` | Types the key of the given option index. |
| `typeOption(String option)` | Selects a dialogue option using the corresponding number key NOT CASE SENSITIVE |
